title: Need for Speed: Shift Xbox 360
renderer: Process 2 native Vulkan plugin consuming the live retail guest draw stream; no Xenos GPU-render path or synthetic fragment color

build.apk_method: Started from the APK pulled from the phone, replaced only the two P2 plugin aliases, aligned and signed it with the same debug certificate, then installed without Android Incremental Install. A full Gradle Android APK rebuild did not complete.

loading_screen.observation: Original retail SHIFT loading logo and yellow-orange progress bar are visible. The language selector has not appeared yet.

after_loading.observation: The display turns black before the language selector or EA Intro becomes visible.

runtime_log.first_refresh_failure: 2026-10-25 12:53:53.450 local: Vulkan frame refresh failed for 1280x720 with 24 captured draws; mixed 4x-to-1x depth/stencil preservation requires a provider-confirmed enabled resolve capability
runtime_log.interpretation: The P2 plugin fails closed because the Android provider used by this APK was built from /home/pes/work/rexglue-sdk-v0.10.0-android, whose Vulkan provider header has no with_depth_stencil_resolve option. The optional provider capability implementation is available in Process 2 SDK commit fb151b9 on work/process2-vulkan-resolve-capability-20261024. The phone did not reach the language selector; this run does not verify selector labels.

limitations: The full Gradle Android APK rebuild did not complete; the phone package was assembled by replacing only the two Vulkan plugin libraries in the APK already installed on the device.
The Android provider capability has not yet been integrated into the runtime used by the phone package.
The Linux retail before/after captures show the language labels after the shader varying fix, but the same selector has not been visually recaptured on the phone.
